channel.title: Kukie GitOps on History
channel.description: Recent content in Kukie GitOps on History

item.title: Kukie GitOps.05 Isolating Helm Rendering
item.description: Running customer Helm charts in a dedicated pod — why it left the shared agent, what helm reads from a chart, process limits, matching Argo CD’s render conditions, and a NetworkPolicy controller that had been off all along.

item.title: Kukie GitOps.04 Finding Helm Values
item.description: Finding which values key controls a rendered field in 21 public Helm charts — judging keys by marker rendering, narrowing candidates, why 18 of 209 fields were missed, comparing code with an LLM on five charts, and what a single render costs.

item.title: Kukie GitOps.03 Merge Approval
item.description: From an approval click to a merged pull request — rechecking file blobs and base before merging, the missing server route that left a card spinning, recording the merge first, separating the response from sync watching after a CloudFront 504, and replacing a stale AI answer with a code-written sentence.

item.title: Kukie GitOps.02 Pull Requests from Chat
item.description: From a chat request to an opened pull request — verifying GitHub App install callbacks, deciding between PR and kubectl per resource, steering the LLM with ModelRetry and a one-line history memo instead of prompts, code-chosen edits for plain YAML and Kustomize, and render comparison against an expected result.

item.title: Kukie GitOps.01 Reading GitOps Clusters
item.description: Before a chat-driven kubectl change gets silently reverted — a measured selfHeal revert in about six seconds, detecting ArgoCD-managed resources from tracking-id and instance labels, warn-then-allow approval cards, the real scope of a cluster-admin connection role, and the read-only views built on Application resources.
